findings.detail: A07 reported pct_sum=0.0%, but the SOI discloses Total Investments at 103.1% with fair value 329,255.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation found the filing schedule total fair value of 329,255 ties to the bundle's 329.255 million fund-quarter FV and statement totals, while the raw SOI explicitly carries Total Investments - 103.1%. The flagged observed pct_sum of 0.0% is therefore not supported by the raw source; it reflects a missed extraction of the schedule percentage.
